mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doc_version (doc_id, version, content_md, content_hash, change_note) VALUES (#{docId}, #{version}, #{contentMd}, #{contentHash}, #{changeNote})
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, version, content_hash, change_note, created_at FROM doc_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY version DESC
SELECT id, doc_id, version, content_md, content_hash, change_note, created_at FROM doc_version WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND version = #{version}
